description: This file defines the 'Sequential' container class in the PyTorch C++ API, which manages a list of modules that are executed sequentially. It includes class definitions for SequentialImpl and Sequential, with methods for construction, cloning, forwarding, and module management.

classes.name: SequentialImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a sequential container of modules, supporting construction, cloning, forwarding, and module management.

classes.name: Sequential
classes.description: A module holder for SequentialImpl, providing a user-facing interface for sequential module containers.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Sequential container, optionally on a specified device.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Empty implementation; does not reset parameters as Sequential has none.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Outputs a simple description of the Sequential container.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Feeds input through the sequence of modules, returning the final output.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds a new module to the sequence, with multiple overloads for different input types.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Appends multiple modules from a container.

methods.name: ptr
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the module at a given index.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a module at a specific index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of modules in the sequence.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the sequence contains no modules.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Returns a reference to the module at a specific index, cast to a specified type.
